title: Print spooler keeps stopping
symptom: Nothing prints from one PC and the Print Spooler service keeps stopping
user_description: Nothing I send to the printer comes out. Imran says it's my PC because his prints fine. I've restarted twice and it worked for five minutes, then stopped again.

options.text: Reinstall Windows to fix the printing system
options.why: Far too drastic. The spooler can usually be fixed in a few minutes.

options.text: Stop the Print Spooler service, delete the stuck files in C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS, start the service again, and if it keeps stopping, update or remove the faulty printer driver
options.why: A corrupt stuck job can crash the spooler again and again. Clearing the queue folder removes it, and a bad driver is the other common cause.

options.text: Restart the PC every time it stops
options.why: Restarting only brings the spooler back until it meets the same stuck job or bad driver again.

options.text: Delete every printer for every user on the PC
options.why: Removes far more than needed and creates more work, while the stuck job may still be there.

hints: What service handles printing in Windows?
Why might it crash again right after restarting?
Where does Windows keep jobs waiting to print?
real_world_tip: Check Event Viewer for spooler errors that name a driver. Updating that one driver often stops the crashes for good.
